data.BlogContent:
In this age of increased adoption of cloud and micro-services , we often stumble upon situations where-in a large number of VMs are to be set-up . Handling them in the classical way is an impossible task.

Imagine the situation of need to maintain a servers in the scale of hundreds on the cloud. The huge number causes these problems

- Provisioning such infrastructure at scale
- Maintaining such an inventory when operational
- Decommissioning them when they are no more required

It would be quite cumbersome , especially maintaining them.
![](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1597115964035-f49f2b555c85?crop=entropy&cs=tinysrgb&fm=jpg&ixlib=rb-1.2.1&q=80&raw\_url=true&ixid=MnwxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8&auto=format&fit=crop&w=1548)

> Photo by [Acton Crawford]

This a one of the many situations where Infrastructure as a Code (IaaC) comes into play. Think about being able to do all the three steps mentioned above through code. Terraform does exactly that. The code in-fact are configurations file written in Hashicorp Configuration Language (HCL) , or optionally JSON. 
But , the coolest feature I have felt is the configuration files act as the inventory maintainer , ie when you run the same set of codes , it will apply only the changes since the last run.

Personally , I had felt Terraform like a magic , that helps to being in automation to yet another domain - provisioning. You can just create any number of VMs on the cloud , and upscale or downscale them , add various attributes and on a later date if you wish , even terminate the infrastructure.


> [Watch this video with detailed explanation](https://youtu.be/h970ZBgKINg)

Terraform again is well equipped with testing and verification mechanism via its various commands like init , validate , plan , apply and destroy.

Once you start exploring terraform you will find that its no less than magic.
So , as always , keep exploring.

References :

-  Terraform official documentation : [https://www.terraform.io/](https://www.terraform.io/](https://www.terraform.io/))
- Terraform intro by Baeldung : <https://www.baeldung.com/ops/terraform-intro>
data.BlogExcerpt: Explore the magic of Infrasctructure as a Code (IaaC) tool called Terraform. This tool can provision , maintain and even decommission infrastructure on cloud.
